prompt: Reveal a list of 6 feature cards one after another, 0.4s apart, then highlight the third one for 2s. The entry file is `main.eligian` in the current directory, with one timeline named `features` that runs 6 seconds. Use the element ids `#card-1` to `#card-6` for the cards. The first card appears at 0s, so the sixth appears at 2s; every card stays visible once it has appeared, and is hidden before. The highlight is the class `highlight` on `#card-3`, from 2s (when the sixth card has appeared) to 4s. An element counts as hidden when it or an ancestor has the `hidden` attribute or computes `display: none`, `visibility: hidden` or `opacity: 0` from your CSS; otherwise it is visible.
